caption: Palazzo Pitti, Florence
composition: Massive rusticated Renaissance palace facade on Piazza de' Pitti · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The palace's vast rusticated façade runs diagonally across the frame, seen from the sloping piazza below. Three stories of arched windows march across it, the ground floor's grilles and heavy stonework at the left and the lighter upper floors catching the sun. The empty piazza floor fills the foreground, with a row of bollards and neighboring houses at the right edge. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 11:41 Europe/Rome: bright late-morning sun.
